questions.question: Among the following, which is the unit of adiabatic compressibility?

explanations.a: Incorrect. This is the unit of pressure or bulk modulus.
explanations.b: Correct. m²/N is the unit of compressibility.

questions.question: Compressibility of a medium is defined as the reciprocal of

explanations.a: Incorrect. Compressibility is not the inverse of Young's modulus.
explanations.b: Incorrect. Rigidity modulus relates to shear stress.
explanations.d: Correct. Compressibility is 1 divided by bulk modulus.
